question: Should the dashboard agent-status widget proceed now as a sessions.list-backed builtin through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826, or wait for the richer sessions.activity Gateway contract before this issue is considered solved?
rationale: The UI need is clear, but the permanent source of truth for current task, progress, attention, and cross-agent activity is a product/API sequencing decision rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep staged widget candidate
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate UI solution, with normal review/proof/conflict/security blockers clearing before this issue closes.

options.title: Wait for activity contract
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 lands a richer sessions.activity API, then build the widget against that contract.

options.title: Fold into roadmap tracker
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 own the sequencing after preserving this issue's unique agent-status requirements there.

recommendation.title: Keep staged widget candidate
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate UI solution, with normal review/proof/conflict/security blockers clearing before this issue closes.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the official maintainer and the strongest current routing signal for accepting a new bundled Control UI/dashboard surface.
